stops and unregisters one instance, keeping its configuration and data

Usage: dolos service uninstall [OPTIONS] [NAME]

Arguments:
  [NAME]  The instance's name, which needs no configuration; without it, derived from the
          configuration as `install` derives it

Options:
      --system           A system unit, removed as root (Linux only); without NAME, derived from the
                         file `--config` names
      --format <FORMAT>  How to print the result: text for people, JSON for scripts [default: text]
                         [possible values: text, json]
  -c, --config <CONFIG>  
  -h, --help             Print help
